errors.quote: which Agnes had assigned to torment Theodore
errors.wrong: The reader thinks Agnes assigned the reports and sheets herself and then threw them away. In the original they were sent to Agnes (dative) so that she would torment Theodore with them.
The reader thinks this means 'Planes' (worlds or planes of existence). The original says 'Плани', the Plans, the same term rendered 'Plans' in the next paragraph.
